scope: Same-engine comparison of direct Database and ConcurrentDatabase; diagnostic only
protocol: Three fixed alternating pairs of 512 single-row inserts per facade, using fresh copies of one 16384-row checkpoint with 1024-byte content; all five result columns and complete recovered row counts checked.
clock_units: Integer microseconds. Non-WAL-sync duration includes all time outside the reported WAL sync. Outside-statement duration includes wrapper, telemetry and publication work; it is not a direct publication timer.
tail_definition: The slowest 26 complete requests of each 512-request case; fraction is sum(WAL sync time)/sum(total request time) over those same requests.
toolchain: Rust 1.97.1; default HawDB features; optimized release with thin LTO and one codegen unit
host: AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS, 16 logical CPUs, Linux 7.1.10-zen1-1-zen; shared workstation, NVMe/Btrfs fixtures
acceptance: diagnostic_only; cross-version performance gate remains not qualified
